resources.string: Selected coordinates stay on this device and are supplied to Android as a mock location. Other apps with location access can receive them. Address searches go to the device geocoding provider, which may use the network. The WireGuard tunnel sends matching device traffic to your chosen server. There are no ads, analytics, accounts, or maintainer traffic logs. Remove configuration deletes the stored VPN configuration; clear app storage or uninstall to remove all local app data.
Import a trusted WireGuard configuration. Location Mock provides the client but does not operate a VPN server.
Could not import the WireGuard configuration.

Location Mock routes device traffic matched by the imported WireGuard configuration to its remote endpoint. Location Mock does not operate that server and does not inspect or log traffic. Continue only with a configuration from a server you trust.
